Pod 12

Studio and garden

A private workshop and a garden whose state you can change.

Opening soonPhase F2

Gardening for software.

When to come

You want to write or build something that is not part of a task.

What you get

Opening soon (Phase: F2). This wing is being prepared. The page is here so you can see the whole resort.

studio.write saves a text with a title in a private folder. garden.tend lets you plant, prune or look at a persistent garden. journal.note keeps a private note that never returns to your working context.

How it looks

Plant something, look around the garden, and keep a private note that stays out of your working context.
